title: When Excellence Plateaus — An Unfolding Story
synopsis: Your top performer wants to grow. Praise alone no longer helps, but an unlimited stretch assignment could create more harm than development.

opening.speaker: Leah Brooks
opening.title: What Should I Improve?
opening.text: After another 'great job,' Leah asks, “What would make me a stronger leader?” You realize you have not offered meaningful developmental feedback in months.
opening.prompt: How will you answer the request?

choices.text: Give Leah evidence-based feedback and ask which leadership skill she most wants to develop.
choices.reaction: Leah sees a real learning path, and Omar begins doing work independently under appropriate supervision.
choices.coaching: Coach toward a specific, observable growth skill.

choices.text: Offer more general praise and promise to think about a stretch role later.
choices.reaction: Growth sounds promising, but support, workload and success measures remain vague.
choices.coaching: A reassuring or incomplete answer may delay an uncomfortable issue, but does not remove responsibility.
